title: Composite Index
description: Composite Index is a analysis ability in the Ecosystem Health Indexing database. Combines dozens of signals into one 0–100 health index. Signals are normalized and weighted; the index is the weighted mean. It takes signals and produces index. Tunable parameters: 0–100. Guarantee: the index is always explainable by its parts.

fields.mechanism: Signals are normalized and weighted; the index is the weighted mean.
fields.guarantees: the index is always explainable by its parts

demo.code:
function index(parts){var s=parts.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;},0);return s/parts.length;}
console.log('Health index: '+index([3,17,70]).toFixed(1));

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Signal Weighting
description: Signal Weighting is a analysis ability in the Ecosystem Health Indexing database. Weights signals by how well they predict real incidents. Weights are learned from incident history; predictive signals weigh more. It takes incidents and produces weights. Tunable parameters: learned. Guarantee: weights are always published.

fields.mechanism: Weights are learned from incident history; predictive signals weigh more.

title: Trend Arrows
description: Trend Arrows is a analysis ability in the Ecosystem Health Indexing database. Shows whether health is improving or degrading and how fast. The 7-day slope of the index sets the arrow; steep drops alert. It takes index history and produces arrows. Tunable parameters: 7 d slope. Guarantee: arrows never hide a drop.

fields.mechanism: The 7-day slope of the index sets the arrow; steep drops alert.

title: Component Drill-Down
description: Component Drill-Down is a analysis ability in the Ecosystem Health Indexing database. Drills from the index into the exact failing components. Each index component links to its signals and the raw events behind them. It takes index and produces drill view. Tunable parameters: per component. Guarantee: drill-down never dead-ends.

fields.mechanism: Each index component links to its signals and the raw events behind them.

title: Peer Comparison
description: Peer Comparison is a analysis ability in the Ecosystem Health Indexing database. Compares an ecosystem's health against similar ecosystems. Cohorts of similar size and type provide percentile context. It takes cohorts and produces percentiles. Tunable parameters: n≥10. Guarantee: comparisons never name the peers.

fields.mechanism: Cohorts of similar size and type provide percentile context.

title: Incident Correlation
description: Incident Correlation is a analysis ability in the Ecosystem Health Indexing database. Correlates index drops with real incidents to validate the signals. Each drop is matched to incident records; unmatched drops trigger signal review. It takes incidents and produces correlation. Tunable parameters: per drop. Guarantee: unmatched drops always trigger review.

fields.mechanism: Each drop is matched to incident records; unmatched drops trigger signal review.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Early Warnings
description: Early Warnings is a analysis ability in the Ecosystem Health Indexing database. Warns before the index crosses critical thresholds. The forecast of the index triggers warnings 7 days before a projected crossing. It takes forecast and produces warnings. Tunable parameters: 7 d ahead. Guarantee: warnings always include the drivers.

fields.mechanism: The forecast of the index triggers warnings 7 days before a projected crossing.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Health History
description: Health History is a analysis ability in the Ecosystem Health Indexing database. Keeps the full history of the index for long-term review. Daily index values are retained for 5 years with their component breakdowns. It takes index series and produces history. Tunable parameters: 5 y. Guarantee: history is never rewritten.

fields.mechanism: Daily index values are retained for 5 years with their component breakdowns.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Custom Signals
description: Custom Signals is a analysis ability in the Ecosystem Health Indexing database. Lets operators add their own signals to the index. Custom signals plug in with a weight and normalization; they appear in drill-downs. It takes signal defs and produces extended index. Tunable parameters: per signal. Guarantee: custom signals are always labeled.

fields.mechanism: Custom signals plug in with a weight and normalization; they appear in drill-downs.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Alert Routing
description: Alert Routing is a analysis ability in the Ecosystem Health Indexing database. Routes health alerts to the right owners automatically. Each component maps to an owner; alerts follow the map with escalation. It takes ownership map and produces routed alerts. Tunable parameters: per component. Guarantee: alerts never go unowned.

fields.mechanism: Each component maps to an owner; alerts follow the map with escalation.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Recovery Tracking
description: Recovery Tracking is a analysis ability in the Ecosystem Health Indexing database. Tracks recovery after an incident until health is restored. Post-incident the index is watched; recovery closes only after 7 clean days. It takes incidents and produces recovery status. Tunable parameters: 7 d clean. Guarantee: recovery never closes early.

fields.mechanism: Post-incident the index is watched; recovery closes only after 7 clean days.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Health Reports
description: Health Reports is a analysis ability in the Ecosystem Health Indexing database. Publishes a weekly health report in plain language. The report covers the index, movers, and actions in sentences. It takes index data and produces report. Tunable parameters: weekly. Guarantee: reports never bury bad news.

fields.mechanism: The report covers the index, movers, and actions in sentences.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: What-If Modeling
description: What-If Modeling is a analysis ability in the Ecosystem Health Indexing database. Models how planned changes would move the index. Changes are simulated against the signal model; the projected delta is shown. It takes plans and produces projection. Tunable parameters: simulated. Guarantee: projections are always labeled estimates.

fields.mechanism: Changes are simulated against the signal model; the projected delta is shown.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Threshold Tuning
description: Threshold Tuning is a analysis ability in the Ecosystem Health Indexing database. Tunes alert thresholds from false-positive history. Thresholds adjust to keep false positives under 5% while catching real drops. It takes alert history and produces thresholds. Tunable parameters: auto. Guarantee: tuning never silences a real drop.

fields.mechanism: Thresholds adjust to keep false positives under 5% while catching real drops.
fields.guarantees: tuning never silences a real drop

title: Ecosystem Map
description: Ecosystem Map is a analysis ability in the Ecosystem Health Indexing database. Draws the ecosystem as a map colored by component health. Components render as regions; color is the component score. It takes components and produces map. Tunable parameters: per component. Guarantee: the map always matches the index.

fields.mechanism: Components render as regions; color is the component score.
fields.guarantees: the map always matches the index
